title: Platform profile
description: A profile (profiles/*.json in this repo) selects which skills, MCP servers, gates and docRelevantPaths apply to a consumer. Layered under a pack's own additions, per the DAC precedence order: platform defaults -> profile -> pack -> lock overrides.

humanMaintainers.description: GitHub logins allowed to perform the HITL merge or dispatch merge-gate (route B).

docRelevantPaths.description: Glob-like path prefixes whose changes require docImpact != none (CIR-14 doc-drift check).

testingProfiles.description: Which risk-based testing profiles (H4/W6) this consumer's stack can actually run; selection by SDD level happens at runtime, this just bounds what's available.

requiredFiles.description: Platform-owned v2 files the profile's commands depend on implicitly (e.g. pytest.ini for `pytest`). `migrate` never retires them, even when identical to the Template.

productSetupCommand.description: Command the L3 consumer gate runs (from the pinned platform profile, never from the consumer PR) before productTestCommand to install the consumer's dependencies on a clean runner; null means no setup.

productTestCommand.description: Command pr-gate runs for CI-02; null means NOT_APPLICABLE, not FAIL.
